sentences.en: The rain prevented us from finishing our game of tennis.
sentences.zh: 1. 雨阻止了我们完成网球比赛。

sentences.en: The rainy weather prevented her from working in the garden.
sentences.zh: 2. 多雨的天气使她无法在花园里工作。

sentences.en: The heavy snowfall prevented our train from leaving on time.
sentences.zh: 3. 恶劣的大雪导致我们的火车未能按时出发。
